newsitem.title: USA: PSI Energy says redeems 7.15 pct pfd stock.
newsitem.headline: PSI Energy says redeems 7.15 pct pfd stock.

text.p: PSI Energy Inc, a subsidiary of CINergy Corp, said on Thursday it will redeem on September 1 all shares of its 7.15 percent cumalative preferred stock at a price of $101 per share.
The company said that dividends due September 1 on the 7.15 percent preferred stock in the amount of $1.7875 per share will be paid separately in the normal manner.
The redeemed stock is traded on the New York Stock Exchange as the preferred class D shares of Public Service of Indiana under the symbol "PIN."

The company said on and after September 1, all dividends on the shares will cease to accrue and all rights with respect to such shares will cease, except the right to receive the redemption price upon presentation and surrender of certificates for the shares.
CINergy Corp is the holding company of Cincinnati Gas & Electric and PSI Energy.
